summary: PR #129 deletes 60+ agent files and skills/github/ but leaves broken references in 7 surviving source files (agents/integrator.md, CLAUDE.md, skills/closed-loop/SKILL.md, handoffs.md, host.md, pack.md, pack/SETUP.md, pack/MANIFEST.json, and three scripts). The learnings.jsonl removal is half-done: the file is deleted and gitignored, but the orchestrator code, skill docs, and prompt template still reference it. Two critical findings block merge.
goal: Review PR #129 for broken references after agent consolidation

findings.issue: integrator.md dispatches a 'github' subagent and tells agents to read agents/github.md and skills/github, but both were deleted in this PR. This is an actionable instruction that will fail at runtime: the integrator will attempt to dispatch a nonexistent agent for stacked PRs.
findings.fix: Remove the github dispatch instruction from agents/integrator.md line 17-18. Either inline the stacking advice or drop it. The .claude and .codex copies will be regenerated by yarn sync.

findings.issue: The PR removed learnings.jsonl from the protocol (protocol.md step 3 is gone) and from the gitignore re-include, and deleted the file itself, but left active instructions in 5 skill source files telling agents and the orchestrator to use it. SKILL.md step 6 says 'fold new loop/learnings.jsonl entries'. SKILL.md prompt template line 115 says 'Append your new learnings to loop/learnings.jsonl'. handoffs.md line 89 says 'Each learning here MUST also be appended (one line) to loop/learnings.jsonl'. host.md lists it as persistent memory. pack.md references it in the four-layers diagram, the what-stays list, and the roster section. These create contradictory instructions: protocol.md no longer mentions jsonl, but the skill files agents are told to read still mandate it.
findings.fix: Update all 5 skill source files to match the new learning-loop.md model: (1) SKILL.md step 6 should reference the orchestrator retro promoting from handoff learnings, not folding jsonl. (2) SKILL.md prompt template should not mention learnings.jsonl. (3) handoffs.md line 89 should be removed or rewritten. (4) host.md should reference only loop/learnings.md. (5) pack.md should update the four-layers diagram, what-stays list, roster optional agents, and file map.

findings.issue: Line 90 says 'Persist read-only agents' learnings into loop/learnings.jsonl' but learnings.jsonl is deleted and gitignored. This is the project's root instruction file.
findings.fix: Change to match the new model: 'Persist read-only agents' learnings via the orchestrator retro (see learning-loop.md).' or similar.

findings.issue: MANIFEST.json kernel list includes 'skills/github/*.md' (line 10) which was deleted. doNotCopy list includes 'loop/learnings.jsonl' (line 23) which no longer exists.
findings.fix: Remove 'skills/github/*.md' from kernel. Remove 'loop/learnings.jsonl' from doNotCopy.

findings.issue: File tree diagram shows learnings.jsonl (line 59), skills/github/ directory (lines 82-83), .cursor/skills/github/ (line 105), and .claude/skills/github/ (line 108). All were deleted or will not be generated.
findings.fix: Remove learnings.jsonl and skills/github lines from the tree diagram.

findings.issue: init-pack.mjs creates an empty learnings.jsonl on pack install. export-template.mjs creates one in the template. pack-copy.mjs includes !loop/learnings.jsonl in gitignore output. All reference a file the new model does not use and the gitignore no longer re-includes.
findings.fix: Remove learnings.jsonl creation from init-pack and export-template. Remove the gitignore negation from pack-copy.

findings.issue: The orchestrator code still reads/writes learnings.jsonl. This is not broken at runtime (readLedger gracefully handles missing file and recreates it), but it contradicts the PR's intent to remove learnings.jsonl from the workflow. The prompt template in stages.ts:69 tells agents to append to learnings.jsonl.
findings.fix: If learnings.jsonl is truly being removed, update retro.ts to promote directly to target files and update stages.ts prompt. If it is intentionally kept as a runtime-only transient file, document that clearly.

findings.issue: These lines reference '22 agent files' but the PR consolidated to 8 agents. The count is stale.
findings.fix: Update to '8 agent files' or remove the specific count.

findings.issue: The roster section still lists Optional agents (design-ux, devops, docs, github, release, monitor, debugger) and Specialists (frontend, backend, data, mobile, performance, compliance, cost) that were all deleted in this PR. team.md and stages.md were updated to remove these but pack.md was not.
findings.fix: Update the roster to match the new 8-agent model. Remove references to deleted optional and specialist agents.

findings.issue: References 'The verifier and devops agents read this list' but devops was deleted.
findings.fix: Change to 'The verifier reads this list' or 'The verifier agent reads this list'.

findings.issue: Handoff section says 'nextStage: release' but the release agent was deleted and stages.md no longer includes a release stage.
findings.fix: Remove 'nextStage: release' or change to indicate integrator is the terminal stage.

findings.issue: References 'frontend.md / design-ux.md' as examples of stale product facts. These files were deleted, so the example now refers to deleted files. Technically this is historical context that still makes sense as a cautionary tale, but could be confusing.
findings.fix: Consider adding '(since removed)' to clarify these are historical examples.

findings.issue: EMPTY_LEDGER constant still uses the old learnings.md format with Standing rules, By topic sections, and Recently applied. The actual loop/learnings.md was reformatted to just Open Questions. If retro.ts creates a fresh learnings.md it will use the old format.
findings.fix: Update EMPTY_LEDGER to match the new Open Questions format, or defer if the orchestrator code is planned for a separate update.

learnings.insight: When deleting a file referenced across multiple layers (skill docs, protocol, scripts, orchestrator code, host config), all layers must be updated in the same PR. This PR removed learnings.jsonl from protocol.md and learning-loop.md but left 5 skill source files, 3 scripts, the orchestrator code, CLAUDE.md, and 2 pack files still referencing it.
learnings.action: After deleting a file, grep the entire repo for its name and update every surviving reference before marking the PR ready.

learnings.insight: agents/integrator.md still dispatches a 'github' subagent and references agents/github.md and skills/github, both deleted.
learnings.action: Remove the github dispatch from integrator.md line 17-18 and update the nextStage on line 35 from 'release' to reflect that integrator is terminal.

learnings.insight: This PR reviewed 322 changed files (13,637 diff lines). The structural changes to skill source files (pack.md, SKILL.md, host.md, handoffs.md) were incomplete relative to the protocol and learning-loop changes.
learnings.action: When reviewing large PRs that change a system's layered architecture, verify each layer independently rather than trusting that changes at one layer propagated to all others.
